verdict.rationale: The IRS runs machine interfaces (MeF XML/SOAP A2A, IRIS A2A), so asking for an interactive API reference is a fair question. The evidence shows its developer surface is PDF publications with registration-gated schemas and no interactive reference. All OpenAPI/Swagger probe paths return 404, and developer.irs.gov does not resolve. The ATS test environment is an enrollment-gated testing system, not an explorable reference with runnable examples, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
